checkpoints: 检查新增的验证方法是否有对应的单元测试
确认测试是否覆盖了正常路径和异常路径（如 PCP+DP 同时启用时应抛出 ValueError）

antipattern.code:
# vllm_ascend/platform.py
# AscendPlatform 类中新增的 PCP+DP 验证方法

@classmethod
def check_and_update_config(cls, vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> None:
    # ... 其他配置检查 ...
    cls._validate_parallel_config(vllm_config)
    cls._validate_layer_sharding_config(vllm_config)

@classmethod
def _validate_parallel_config(cls, vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> None:
    """Validate parallel config for Ascend platform."""
    # gemini-code-assist[bot] high：parallel_config 可能为 None
    # 在某些配置或单元测试中会导致 AttributeError
    parallel_config = vllm_config.parallel_config
    if (parallel_config.data_parallel_size > 1 and
            parallel_config.prefill_context_parallel_size > 1):
        raise ValueError("PCP + DP is not supported in vLLM Ascend.")

@classmethod
def _validate_parallel_config(cls, vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> None:
    """Validate parallel config for Ascend platform."""
    parallel_config = vllm_config.parallel_config
    # gemini-code-assist[bot] suggestion：添加防御性 None 检查（+2 行）
    if parallel_config is None:
        return
    if (parallel_config.data_parallel_size > 1 and
            parallel_config.prefill_context_parallel_size > 1):
        raise ValueError("PCP + DP is not supported in vLLM Ascend.")
